run_simple_video_convert_frames_to_mp4: run the script to convert a folder of image frames into an mp4 video at 30fps
run_simple_video_convert_frames_to_webm: run the script to convert image frames into a webm video using libvpx-vp9 encoding
run_simple_video_convert_frames_to_mov: run the script to convert image frames into a mov video using prores_ks encoding
run_simple_video_scale_and_convert: run the script with a scale factor to resize frames before encoding into a video
run_simple_video_default_output: run the script without an output flag to auto-name the video after the input folder
